conclusion_scope: In the frozen software environment and OFT configuration used in this study, FP16 autocast produced numerical instability, whereas full FP32 training remained stable. This is not asserted as a general incompatibility between FP16 autocast and Cayley-Neumann OFT beyond the tested configuration.
condition: dtype=torch.float32 (default) backbone load + Seq2SeqTrainingArguments(fp16=True) -- i.e. "standard" AMP recipe (fp32 weights + autocast), isolating loading dtype from autocast
finding: NaN reproduced even with standard-recipe AMP (fp32-loaded weights + autocast). This isolates the cause to FP16 autocast itself (not to the non-standard fp16-preload pattern flagged by HF troubleshooting docs, which was ruled out by this test).
